name: St Aldric's Academy
summary: Secondary school: parents, the local authority, suppliers and exam boards.

company.name: St Aldric's Academy
company.description: An 11–18 secondary academy in Nottingham with 1,100 pupils. The school receives email from parents (absences, bullying concerns, trips, uniform, SEND support), the local authority, catering and transport suppliers, and exam boards. It is mock exam season, a Year 9 trip to the Peak District is next week, and the school is rolling out a new parent payment system that has had teething problems.
